description:
Stay prepared by having quick access to your Narcan with our Narcan Nasal Spray Pouch. The Narcan pouch is designed to hold one dose (4mg) of Narcan nasal spray – Spray Not Included.

 

Within Arm’s Reach:

  • The Narcan spray is designed to fit around standard duty belts up to 2 inches, keeping your medical supplies alongside you for emergency use. This case is great for law enforcement, public safety, EMTs, active-duty personnel, and more.

 

Safe and Secure:

  • These Narcan pouches feature a front flap with a hook & loop closure for easy and fast access while ensuring your Narcan spray stays in place when on duty.

 

Strong Material Construction:

  • Made of 600D polyester, these Narcan nasal spray pouches are built to withstand the rush of medical emergencies while protecting your Narcan from dirt and debris.

 

Ready for Duty:

  • A red 6-point Star of Life logo is displayed on the front of the Narcan utility pouch for quick and easy identification. Measuring 4 inch x 4.5 inch x 1.5 inch, the medic case can also hold additional emergency supplies when carrying a single dose of Narcan.
